visual_base.visual_narrative_log:
(1) Two shirtless men stand in a well-lit martial arts gym. One man, on the left, wears black shorts and blue boxing gloves, with a text label identifying him as 'Fitness Fanatic'. The other man, on the right, wears gold and black patterned shorts, labeled as 'MMA Fighter'. The gym environment is filled with gray mats, blue and black wall padding, and banners for 'IFighting' and 'IMMAF'. The 'Fitness Fanatic' delivers a leg kick to the 'MMA Fighter' at 20% intensity, while the camera remains static at eye level capturing their full bodies.
(2) The intensity increases through cuts to '40%' and '60%'. The 'Fitness Fanatic' executes more forceful kicks against the 'MMA Fighter's' thigh. The 'MMA Fighter' maintains a stoic posture and a neutral facial expression, absorbing the impact without moving his feet. The background remains consistent, showing a black punching bag and white equipment shelves. The lighting is bright and even across the scene.
(3) At '80%' and '100%' intensity, the 'Fitness Fanatic' uses more hip rotation for the kicks. After the 100% kick, the 'MMA Fighter' smiles and gives a thumbs-up. They briefly share a laugh, with the 'MMA Fighter' pointing at his leg, which shows slight redness. The text overlays change dynamically to reflect the power level.
(4) The roles switch. The 'MMA Fighter' now kicks the 'Fitness Fanatic'. Starting at 20%, 40%, and 60%, the kicks are delivered with precise technique. The 'Fitness Fanatic' shows more visible physical tension, bracing his core and exhaling sharply. The camera pans slightly to follow the movement as they shift positions on the mat.
(5) The final segment shows the 80% and 100% kicks from the 'MMA Fighter'. Upon impact at 100%, the 'Fitness Fanatic'winces and hops on one leg to shake off the pain, while the 'MMA Fighter' laughs. The video ends with a shot of both men bowing deeply to each other in the center of the gym, a traditional sign of respect in martial arts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log:
(1) A sharp, percussive thud sounds as the first kick connects, followed immediately by the rustling of fabric. A male voice speaks calmly in the background. The acoustic space has a slight reverb typical of an indoor gym. A faint Lo-fi beat plays in the background, providing a consistent rhythmic floor.
(2) Repeated impacts of increasing loudness signal the 40% and 60% kicks. Each thud is accompanied by the sound of skin-on-skin impact. Voices are heard laughing and speaking in a mix of English and Japanese with friendly tones, showing moderate arousal. The Lo-fi music continues at a low volume.
(3) Loud, resonant slapping sounds indicate forceful 80% and 100% impacts. The vocal reactions become more pronounced with 'oh' and 'woo' exclamations. The impact sound has a wide spectral bandwidth, sounding very solid and heavy. The ambient noise of the room remains low.
(4) The pattern of thuds repeats as the roles switch. The new voice responding to the kicks exhibits higher pitch and vocal tension, including grunts of exertion. The frequency of percussive sounds remains high as the session escalates. The music beat provides a steady contrast to the irregular thuds.
(5) The audio concludes with polite vocal exchanges and the sound of footsteps on the gym mats. The percussive thuds are replaced by conversational speech as the men bow, ending the session with clear, enunciated Japanese phrases of thanks.
